course_name_original: Hydraulic and Pneumatic Machines I - Acţionări hidraulice şi pneumatice I

learning_outcomes.text: Familiarize graduates from mechanical engineering and related fields with a top area of fluid mechanics: hydropneumatic actuators and controls.

Acquire theoretical and practical knowledge regarding the design, execution, operation, and maintenance of hydraulic and pneumatic actuation systems for fixed or mobile technological equipment, as well as automated systems.

syllabus_topics: General characteristics of hydropneumatic actuators, introductory notions on hydraulic actuation systems, definition of actuation systems, classification, advantages and disadvantages of hydropneumatic actuation systems.
Hydraulic fluids used in hydropneumatic actuation systems, physicochemical properties.
Volumetric hydraulic and pneumatic pumps and motors. Constructive solutions, component elements, operating principles.
Apparatus for pressure regulation and control. Constructive solutions, component elements, operating principles.
Apparatus for flow (speed) regulation and control. Constructive solutions, component elements, operating principles.
Distribution apparatus. Constructive solutions, component elements, operating principles.
Auxiliary apparatus. Functional role. Constructive solutions.
Types of hydraulic and pneumatic actuation schemes. Identification of elements in the scheme and description of operation (Reading schemes).

Commissioning of hydraulic and pneumatic installations. Maintenance and operation (Connecting hydraulic installations, Cleaning the installation, Supplying with working fluid, Starting the installation, Deaeration of the installation, Maintenance of hydraulic installations, Troubleshooting and repairing hydraulic installations).
Organology of hydraulic distribution and regulation apparatus.
Description of stands and work through scheme presentation on the board and directly on the stand. Work is done directly on stands, in the presence of the teaching staff and technical personnel.
Testing of axial piston volumetric pumps.
Testing of the manually operated hydraulic distributor.
Testing of hydraulic pressure relief valves.
Completion of activity. Presentation and defense of work results.

assessment_methods.method: Practical activities (laboratory work and notebook presentation)

assessment_rules: The written exam consists of 4 topics, each must be passed with a minimum grade of 5. Practical activities require presenting processed and interpreted results for all lab works. The grade for practical activities is awarded based on the final defense and presentation of the notebook with completed works. A bonus of 1 point is given for participation in course discussions and over 50% attendance, provided all written exam topics are passed.
